import numpy as np

# Data for fiscal years 2010-2012
x = np.array([2010, 2011, 2012])
y = np.array([1293454, 1295591, 1089353])

# Calculate OLS regression
n = len(x)
x_mean = np.mean(x)
y_mean = np.mean(y)

# Calculate slope and intercept
numerator = np.sum((x - x_mean) * (y - y_mean))
denominator = np.sum((x - x_mean) ** 2)
slope = numerator / denominator
intercept = y_mean - slope * x_mean

print(f"x values: {x}")
print(f"y values: {y}")
print(f"x mean: {x_mean}")
print(f"y mean: {y_mean}")
print(f"Slope: {slope}")
print(f"Intercept: {intercept}")
